title: Price-snapshot store — opening and closing numbers for every market we originate

policy.origination_order: side (spread) first, then the total, then the moneyline
policy.snapshot_lifecycle: an opening snapshot is recorded when the market is originated; a closing snapshot is recorded at kickoff; a missed capture is recorded as missed and never back-filled
policy.columns: model fair line, market line and difference are always separate columns; a difference is published only when both of its inputs are published
policy.blank_rule: a value no official source publishes stays blank and carries the 'no official source' flag
policy.difference_rule: difference = model fair line − market line, per market unit
